name: eilikrineia-study
description: Replication package for four preregistered experiments (6,224 trials) on whether a signed, hash-chained record of a coding agent's own claims changes what it claims and what it delivers. Study 3's preregistered human audit of the completion labeller was not completed; in Study 2, a post hoc audit measured its agreement with two human raters on the same 80 messages.

affiliation.name: Codex Hash Research Laboratory, Codex Hash Ltda., Brazil
